answer: Require every new agent to prove a postal address with a mailed ferrous token. The network posts a tag to that address, and scanning its serial code within fourteen days activates the identity. Only one identity is allowed per address for ninety days, and duplicate scans are rejected before any trade. Forging ten thousand fakes would need ten thousand addresses at ten dollars per token and parcel, a bill of one hundred thousand dollars. It works like a falcon returning to one ledge, and the network trusts only an agent found at its fixed perch, while a fake with no perch never gets in.
